_why: The citation ratchet, keyed by CONFIGURATION, because the checker does not measure the same
population in every configuration. With an ORCA checkout resolved, ~527 citations into ORCA's
tree are checked and ~129 paths are external; without one, those same paths fall to external
and the count is drawn from a partly DISJOINT set. A single number enforced across both is not
a threshold on anything: J21 measured seven repairs moving the ORCA-resolved count 92 -> 85 and
the ORCA-absent count 98 -> 98, on the same pinned tree.
A number here is a RATCHET, not an amnesty. It may only go DOWN. Raising it to make a job green
is how a checker becomes decoration (see .github/workflows/ci.yml's own comment, and PITFALLS
P33). Lowering it as citations are genuinely re-derived is the point.
Every reading below was taken on a CLEAN DETACHED WORKTREE at the stated commit, with
node_modules and dist symlinked in. A count taken in the shared working tree is not comparable:
